introH2: ⚽ What types of stays does Buriram have, and how do you pick the right one for a trip to Chang Arena?
introHtml: Most people come to Buriram for two things — to watch Buriram United play at Chang Arena, and to watch the racing at Chang International Circuit. So the first question most trip planners ask is "where do I stay to be close to the stadium?" · But Buriram's hotels don't all look the same — some are large chain hotels where you can walk from your room to the stadium gate in a few minutes, some are stylish design hotels a ten-minute drive from the stadium that still let you head into town to eat, and some are boutiques or budget rooms in town that go easy on the wallet so you can save your budget for match tickets. · A lot of people book purely on distance to the stadium, then find out later there are no restaurants around the hotel — or the opposite, they end up downtown but have to fight long traffic jams on match day. · This article rounds up 10 Buriram stays we've reviewed in depth — stadium-side, near the stadium, and in town. Every one is based on reading real guest reviews, telling you both the upsides and the honest caveats, with a 3-site price compare and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Buriram has no metro. The main ways to get around are private car, rental car, Grab, and motorbike taxi. · Getting to Buriram works three ways — fly into Buriram Airport (BFV), about 30–40 minutes' drive outside town; take a southern Isan railway line train to Buriram station in the city centre; or take a coach or minivan to the Buriram bus terminal (BKS) in town. · The hotel zones in this article: Around Chang Arena (Isan / Samet sub-districts) — walking distance to the stadium or a few minutes' drive, quiet and leafy, but with few restaurants nearby, so you'll want a car or Grab to get into town. · In Buriram town (Nai Mueang / Chumhet sub-districts) — near Saraka Krao Market, restaurants, the railway station and bus terminal, with food easy to find, about a 10–15 minute drive to the stadium. · On big home-match days or MotoGP-level race weekends, traffic gets heavy and hotels across town fill up fast, so book ahead and allow extra travel time.

entries.name: Amari Buriram United
entries.badge: 🏆 Closest to the stadium · highest score
entries.mrtTag: 📍 On the same grounds as the stadium · 2-min walk to Chang Arena

rooms.type: Deluxe Family Pool Terrace Bunkbed (42 sqm)

entries.addr: 444 Moo 15, Buriram–Prakhon Chai Road, Isan sub-district, Mueang Buriram
entries.storyHtml: If there's one hotel Buriram football fans think of before any other, plenty of reviews point here — Amari Buriram United is a 4-star hotel in the Amari brand, part of the ONYX Hospitality group, and it really does sit on the same grounds as Chang Arena (Thunder Castle). The walk from the lobby to the stadium gate takes under 2 minutes, and it's right next to Chang International Circuit, where MotoGP is raced. · It has the highest score in this article at 9.7 from 82 reviews on Trip.com, and ranks #1 of 23 hotels in Buriram on TripAdvisor. · What makes it one of a kind is that it's the only Buriram United–themed hotel in Thailand, decorated in the club's signature blue, with player murals on the walls and some room types that feel like a players' changing room — fun for fans to photograph. · There are 60 rooms, starting at about 41 sqm, which is more spacious than many same-tier hotels in the provinces, and rooms with a balcony facing the fountain and the stadium are the signature view many guests suggest you ask for. · What reviews single out the most is the breakfast buffet, which a great many guests agree is the best they've had in Buriram — Thai, local Isan, and international dishes, all fresh and frequently topped up. · The outdoor saltwater pool got new sun loungers and a more relaxing lounge corner after a renovation, good for the kids to jump in after a day out. · Honest caveats from the reviews: the hotel is stadium-side but about a 10-minute drive from the city centre, with few restaurants nearby, so if you want to eat out or browse the night market you'll need a Grab or your own car; some reviews would like a few common areas kept up better; and a few guests have had rooms cancelled during a renovation period, so confirm your booking before you travel. · This isn't the cheapest option in Buriram, but it's the most fitting choice for anyone who's genuinely here for the stadium — football or racing — because on a busy match day with heavy traffic and scarce parking, being able to walk straight from your room to the stadium is worth more than the price tag.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a room with a balcony facing the fountain and the stadium — a signature view you won't find anywhere else. And check whether your package includes the breakfast buffet; if not, it's about ฿350/person, which many reviews say is worth paying extra for.
pros: On the same grounds as the stadium — a 2-min walk to Chang Arena, hard to match anywhere else
The only Buriram United–themed hotel in Thailand — fun and photogenic
Breakfast buffet that many reviews rate the best in Buriram
Spacious rooms from 41 sqm, clean after the renovation, standard Amari service
cons: Highest price in this article — about a 10-minute drive from the city centre
Few restaurants around the hotel; you'll need a car or Grab to reach town
Some reviews have had rooms cancelled during renovation — confirm your booking (from reviews)

entries.name: Venezia Resort Buriram
entries.mrtTag: 📍 In town, near the City Pillar Shrine · Chang Arena 6–9 km

rooms.type: Double Room (many with a pool-view balcony)

tags: 🛝 Pool with a waterfall + kids' slide
entries.addr: 20/1 Na Sathani Road, Nai Mueang sub-district, Mueang Buriram
entries.storyHtml: If you're coming to Buriram with the family and want a quiet resort feel in town rather than a big tower hotel, Venezia Resort Buriram is a name several reviews mention warmly. · It's a small resort of about 31–40 rooms run by a German owner and his Thai wife, on Na Sathani Road in the Nai Mueang sub-district, about 1.4 km from the City Pillar Shrine (the Rama I monument), close to the railway station and next to Buriram Hospital. · The reviews come from a small sample (Traveloka around 9.0 from a small pool, TripAdvisor about 4.2/5 from 26 reviews) but lean clearly positive. · What sets it apart from a typical in-town hotel is the outdoor pool with a small waterfall and a kids' pool corner with a slide, which is the main reason families with children pick it — the kids have somewhere to splash while the adults relax poolside. · Another signature is the kitchen serving both Thai and European (German-Italian) food from the German owner, which you won't often find at a small in-town resort in the provinces; breakfast has both Thai and Western options, and the coffee is decent. · What reviews agree on is the owner's friendliness — he's hands-on himself — a warm welcome on arrival, large beds, clean rooms, bathrooms many guests call amazing with big towels, and a gym that actually works. · A favourite point for many: the resort is set back from the main road, so it's quieter than you'd expect for somewhere in town — you get the convenience of being in town without putting up with traffic noise all night. · Honest caveats: the review pool is still far smaller than the big hotels; breakfast variety is limited if you stay several nights; some older reviews found the pool water not clear and the balcony hot from the position of the AC unit; and it's about 6–9 km from Chang Arena, so it's not ideal if you're mainly here for the racing. · Best suited to families with kids, road-trippers, and anyone using Buriram as a base for Phanom Rung and Mueang Tam.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the kids are mainly here for the pool, check the pool opening hours with reception first and bring your own pool toys just in case. If you're a light sleeper, request a room away from the road or common areas when booking, and always check the latest opening status before you book, since it's a small resort.
pros: Pool with a waterfall and a kids' pool corner with a slide — great for families with children
Thai-European kitchen from the German owner — not found elsewhere in town
Quieter than expected, set back from the main road, near the City Pillar Shrine and railway station
Owner is hands-on and warm, speaks English and German
cons: Review pool is still small (in the dozens) — read the latest reviews and check the opening status before booking
Breakfast variety is limited if you stay several nights
About 6–9 km from Chang Arena — not ideal if you're mainly here for the racing

entries.name: Modena by Fraser Buriram
entries.badge: 🏟️ Walk to the stadium · plenty of reviews
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Around Chang Arena, Samet sub-district · 5-min walk to the stadium
entries.addr: 111 Moo 16, Buriram–Prakhon Chai Road, Samet sub-district, Mueang Buriram
entries.storyHtml: Among the hotels around Chang Arena, if you measure by sheer volume of reviews, Modena by Fraser Buriram has the most in this article — over 583 reviews on Trip.com, a 9.2 score, and ranked #2 of 23 hotels in Buriram on TripAdvisor. · It's a 4-star hotel in the Frasers Hospitality group, opened in 2018, with 152 rooms in serviced-residence format, right next to Chang Arena, Buriram United's home ground. · The number-one selling point reviews agree on is the location — the walk from the lobby to the stadium gate takes just a few minutes, with some saying two to five. On a big match day when tens of thousands pour into the stadium, staying right beside it means you don't gamble on finding parking and don't get stuck in a long line of cars after the final whistle — you just walk back to your room. · Rooms are residence-style, from a Superior of about 28 sqm up to a high-ceilinged Loft Studio and a 67 sqm One-Bedroom Superior with a separate living room; some have a small kitchenette in the residence style, handy for longer stays. · Real reviews agree the rooms are spacious, very clean, the beds soft, with nice small touches like an in-room speaker. · The shared facilities are well-rounded, with two pools, both outdoor and indoor, which families especially like because the kids can swim in any weather; a 24-hour gym; a steam room; and a massage room many reviews praise. · Breakfast at Bistro@M earns praise for variety — both Thai and international — with fresh ingredients. · Honest caveats: the stadium-side location comes at the cost of being about a 12-minute drive from the town's restaurants and night market; without your own car you'll rely on Grab, which can be hard to get at times; restaurants around the hotel are still sparse; some reviews mention a slight smell inside the building; and prices jump sharply during events at the stadium. · Best suited to football and motorsport fans and families who want a quiet, clean hotel with a pool at an attainable price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you know the date of a Buriram United home match or a race event, book straight away — rooms fill fast and prices climb hard. If you want something different from the entry-level room, ask for a Deluxe Terrace or Loft Studio when you book, and if you don't have a car, check the hotel's shuttle service ahead of time.
pros: Closest location to Chang Arena — a few minutes' walk to the stadium; no parking gamble on match day
Most reviews in this article — 583 reviews · TripAdvisor #2 of 23 hotels
Two pools, 24-hr fitness, steam room, good breakfast at Bistro@M
Spacious, clean rooms, soft beds, consistently praised staff service
cons: About a 12-minute drive from town and the night market; without a car you rely on Grab
Restaurants around the hotel are still sparse · some reviews note a smell in the building
During events at the stadium, prices climb and rooms fill fast (from reviews)

entries.name: Best Western Royal Buriram Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 In town, Jira Road · Chang Arena 10–15 min drive
entries.addr: 332/22-23 Jira Road, Nai Mueang sub-district, Mueang Buriram
entries.storyHtml: If you come to Buriram and want an international-brand hotel in town at an attainable price, Best Western Royal Buriram Hotel is the option many people think of. · It's a 3-star hotel in the Best Western International family, opened in 2013, on Jira Road in the town area, near the Lower Isan Cultural Centre and the Rama I monument. · It scores 8.2 on Trip.com and 4.1/5 on TripAdvisor from 190 reviews, ranking #3 of 23 hotels in Buriram. · What draws people here is the familiar brand name and the predictable room standard. The building is two cheerful four-storey blocks, with 79 marble-floored rooms that feel clean, each with a small seating corner, a fridge, and tea/coffee facilities. · Several reviews say the rooms are larger than expected and the AC cools quickly, which matters a lot in Buriram's heat. · A highlight people mention is the outdoor saltwater pool, gentler on skin and eyes than a typical chlorine pool, good for the kids and for adults cooling off after a full day of driving around. · Another big advantage is the spacious free parking, hard to find at an in-town hotel, ideal for road-trippers on the Lower Isan route to Phanom Rung, Mueang Tam, and Khao Kradong. · It's a few minutes' drive to the Lower Isan Cultural Centre, the Rama I monument, the railway station, and the town markets, while Chang Arena and Chang Circuit are about 10–15 minutes' drive — a middle path for anyone who wants to sleep in town but still reach the stadium. · Honest caveats: reviews on breakfast are fairly mixed, with fewer buffet options at times; some reviews feel the overall standard is starting to cut costs; the lift is fairly small; some staff have limited English; and there's no full fitness centre or spa. · Best suited to business travellers, families road-tripping around Lower Isan, and anyone who wants the reassurance of an international brand on an attainable budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're road-tripping around Lower Isan, make full use of the free parking and plan your route to Phanom Rung, Mueang Tam, and Khao Kradong from town. Reviews on breakfast are mixed, so if you're not fussed about breakfast at the hotel, pick the package without it and head out for rice soup or noodles in town instead.
pros: International Best Western standard in town — quick drive to everything
Spacious free parking — ideal for road-tripping around Lower Isan
Clean marble-floored rooms, fast-cooling AC, stable Wi-Fi · saltwater pool
Friendly staff, 24-hour front desk · TripAdvisor #3
cons: Mixed reviews on breakfast — fewer buffet options at times
Lift is fairly small · some staff have limited English
No full fitness centre/spa · finding food on foot at night without a car is still inconvenient

entries.name: The Crystal Hotel Buriram
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Buriram–Nang Rong Road · 550 m walk to Robinson · 10 min to the stadium
entries.addr: 405 Moo 10, Buriram–Nang Rong Road, Isan sub-district, Mueang Buriram
entries.storyHtml: If there's one hotel in this article reviews call out for "value" most often, many point here — The Crystal Hotel Buriram (formerly X2 Vibe / Cross Vibe Buriram; if you see the old name on a booking site, it's the same place). · It's a 4-star boutique hotel with 68 rooms on Buriram–Nang Rong Road, sitting neatly on the seam between the town and the sports-stadium zone, scoring 9.4 from 179 reviews on Trip.com and about 8.8 on Booking.com. · What sets it apart from many other Buriram hotels is a location that gives you both — a roughly 550-metre walk to Robinson department store, so eating, catching a film, or shopping needs no taxi, while a 10-minute drive reaches Chang International Circuit (3–4 km) and Chang Arena (4–5 km). · You don't have to choose between "stadium-side" and "in town" — you get both within a short drive. · The most talked-about highlight is the outdoor saltwater pool at the centre of the building, ringed by a garden and rooms on three sides, giving it a private, leafy feel, with a separate kids' pool; on some platforms guests give the pool a full 10. · The Pool Access rooms, where you open the door and step straight into the pool, are a highlight families with kids love, and many reviews say they're worth paying extra for. · The rooms are in a modern four-storey building in dark-trimmed brown tones; reviews praise spacious, very clean rooms with soft beds, ice-cold AC, looking more modern than the price. · The breakfast buffet at Crystal Cafe (06:30–10:30) has cooked-to-order eggs and omelettes many guests praise, plus an EV charging point and free parking that suit anyone renting a car for the Buriram–Phanom Rung route. · Honest caveats: you're not right at the stadium gate, so on a big match day this road gets busy and you'll want extra time; some rooms have a less appealing view or face the road, so ask for a higher floor or the pool side; and late-night dining options around the hotel are limited compared with the town-market area. · Best suited to families, couples, and anyone who wants a clean, good-value mid-range hotel that's a walk to the mall and still an easy drive to watch the racing at Chang.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you've got kids or love a swim, pick a Pool Access room where you step straight from your room into the saltwater pool and kids' pool — better value than paying for a standard room. If you're sensitive to noise or want a good view, request a higher floor or a room facing the pool, not the Buriram–Nang Rong Road.
pros: Location gives you both town and stadium — 550 m walk to Robinson, 10-min drive to Chang
Spacious, clean rooms, soft beds, design more modern than the price · score 9.4
Lovely saltwater pool with a kids' pool, Pool Access rooms step straight in
Cooked-to-order eggs at breakfast · free parking with an EV charger
cons: Not right at the stadium gate; the road gets busy on a big match day, so allow extra time
Some rooms have a poorer view or face the road — ask for a higher floor or the pool side
Late-night dining around the hotel is limited compared with the town-market area (from reviews)

entries.type: 4-Star Hotel · In Town, with a Rooftop
entries.name: Alvarez Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 In town, Jira Road · Chang Arena ~6.3 km
entries.addr: 139 Jira Road, Nai Mueang sub-district, Mueang Buriram
entries.storyHtml: If you want to stay in central Buriram on a low-thousands budget but still get a spacious room, a pool, and a rooftop for evening city views, Alvarez Hotel is a name that comes up often among the in-town stays. · It's a 4-star hotel on Jira Road in the Nai Mueang sub-district, opened in 2014, with about 100 rooms, scoring 7.8 on Trip.com and 8.0 on Booking.com. · What draws many people here is getting a spacious room with plenty of facilities for the price. · Real reviews agree the rooms are bigger than the price, clean, and the furniture looks better than the price — many call the rooms modern and well laid out. · A highlight many mention is the rooftop bar/lounge atop the building, where you can sit with an evening drink and take in a wide view of Buriram town — a spot that gives the stay a special atmosphere. · There's also a pool both indoor and outdoor, not often found at same-tier hotels in Buriram, plus a kids' pool, a sauna, a gym, and a massage room. · Breakfast at the Emperor restaurant earns praise for the chef cooking dishes to order, which makes you feel personally looked after; the buffet is about ฿200/adult, or included on some packages. · The central location is near the cultural plaza and the City Pillar Shrine, about 2.6 km from the railway station, easy to get in and out of, with food easy to find. · Honest caveats: the building has been open since 2014 and some spots are showing their age, like the carpet in the lift; hot water in some rooms is slow or inconsistent; pool upkeep is uneven at times and the water is fairly cold; the Wi-Fi signal is unstable in some rooms; and staff with fluent English are limited, so some international guests find communication hard. · On top of that, the central location means a roughly 6.3 km ride to Chang Arena — not within walking distance. · Best suited to business travellers running errands in town, families, and city sightseers who weigh room size and value above being brand-new.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The rooftop bar is the standout here — head up around sunset for a cool breeze and a wide view of town. Some reviews say the hot water is slow, so run the tap a moment before showering, and if you're an international guest, have a translation app ready or jot down place names in Thai.
pros: Rooms bigger than the price, clean, good-looking furniture, on a low-thousands budget
Rooftop bar with evening city views · indoor + outdoor pool, sauna, gym
Breakfast buffet with the chef cooking to order — good value
Central location, easy to get around, near the railway station and bus terminal
cons: Building open since 2014, some spots showing their age · hot water and pool upkeep uneven at times
Staff with fluent English are limited · Wi-Fi unstable in some rooms
About 6.3 km from Chang Arena — needs a ride, not within walking distance

entries.name: Klim Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 In town, ~800 m across from the railway station · stadium 6 km
tags: 🚉 Walk to the railway station across the road
🏊 Pool at the centre of the building
entries.addr: Na Sathani Road, Nai Mueang sub-district, Mueang Buriram
entries.storyHtml: If you've ever driven past Na Sathani Road by the Buriram railway station and seen two clean exposed-concrete buildings that look more like a design studio than a hotel, that's Klim Hotel. · It's a 3-star boutique hotel with 57 rooms, designed by its owner — an architect — sitting in the city centre about 800 metres across from the railway station, within walking distance, scoring 9.2 from 22 reviews on Trip.com. · What people talk about most is the concept — a minimalist loft with unpainted exposed-concrete walls set against light-toned woodwork, and a detail many reviews love: hand-painted headboard art that's different in every room; some rooms have a tuk-tuk illustration, some a quote on a grey wall, so each room has its own character. · It's a design stay at an accessible price, and there still aren't many options like it in Buriram. · The location is a key strength — just about 800 metres across from Buriram railway station, so you can get off the train and wheel your bags here yourself — very handy for anyone arriving on the Isan railway line without needing an onward taxi, and the surrounding town area has restaurants, coffee shops, markets, and convenience stores all close by. · One thing that sets it apart from similarly priced hotels is its in-house café, Klim Kitchen, which roasts its own coffee, the aroma practically ordering for you; breakfast is a buffet that changes daily, with both Thai and Western dishes and home-baked bread that many reviews call varied and fresher than you'd expect at a hundreds-baht hotel. · There's an outdoor pool set between the two concrete buildings that photographs well and feels shaded, plus a massage room and free parking. · Reviews praise very clean rooms, comfortable beds, and bathrooms larger than expected. · Honest caveats: the soundproofing between rooms and a water-pump noise some guests hear at night can bother light sleepers; some Standard rooms have no window or little light, so check before booking; some find the signs to the car park entrance hard to spot; and a destination like Chang Arena is about 6 km away, a 10–15 minute drive. · Best suited to anyone who loves a design stay that photographs well, wants to be central near the railway station at a hundreds-baht price, and travellers arriving by train.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If natural light matters to you, request a room with a window when you book, since some Standard rooms have none. If you're a light sleeper, ask for a quiet corner room far from the pump room and pack earplugs just in case. Start the morning with the house-roasted coffee at Klim Kitchen before you head out.
pros: Lovely exposed-concrete loft design, photographs well, full of character, at a hundreds-baht price
~800 m across from the railway station — get off the train and wheel your bags right over
Klim Kitchen café roasts its own coffee; breakfast is varied and changes daily
Very clean rooms, comfortable beds, a pool at the centre of the building, free parking
cons: Soundproofing between rooms and water-pump noise on some nights
Some Standard rooms have no window or little light — check before booking
Far from Chang Arena — about a 10–15 minute drive

entries.name: Cresco Hotel Buriram
entries.badge: 🎨 Loft design · near the stadium ~800 m
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Buriram–Prakhon Chai Road · near Chang Arena ~800 m
entries.addr: 333 Moo 4, Buriram–Prakhon Chai Road, Isan sub-district, Mueang Buriram
entries.storyHtml: If you're coming to Buriram for football or racing but don't want a chain hotel that looks the same everywhere, Cresco Hotel Buriram is the option guests talk about most for its design. · It's a small boutique hotel of 40 rooms, designed in an Industrial Loft style with dark grey and black tones mixed with warm lighting and exposed concrete, under a Feels Like Home concept, averaging about 8.8–9.2 across platforms. · The location highlight is that the hotel sits just about 800 metres from Chang Arena and Chang International Circuit, which many reviews say is an easy 10–15 minute walk or a short ride — so on a big match day you largely sidestep the long traffic jams and the post-match scramble for parking. · The detail that makes a Cresco room instantly recognisable is its raw, dark-toned loft styling and glass-walled bathroom, which makes the room feel open and cool; many people love how good it looks and photographs (most have a curtain or sliding panel you can close). · Rooms come in three types with cheeky concept names — Novem Room, Epic Suite, and Copia Family Suite, which has both a rain shower and a soaking tub, good for families. · The shared facilities include an outdoor saltwater pool set in front of the loft-style restaurant building, clear and easy on the eyes, with a separate kids' zone, a gym, a steam room, and a massage room. · The 1UP! Cuisine restaurant beside the pool has a nice atmosphere, and breakfast earns praise for variety and fresh ingredients. · Reviews praise clean rooms larger than expected, comfortable beds, and a design that makes it feel like staying at a big-city hotel; staff are professional and friendly, and some international reviews praise their good English. · Honest caveats: the glass-walled bathroom means some couples will have to accept the lack of privacy; the dark-toned lighting makes the room rather dim for some; the TV signal is unsteady in some rooms; small cleaning details like under the bed could be done more thoroughly; and the hotel sits on a main road rather than in the restaurant district, so without a car you'll rely on Grab. · Best suited to couples who want a photogenic room, football and motorsport fans who want a walkable stay near the stadium, and small families who want a pool on a modest budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're not used to a glass-walled bathroom, ask about the curtain or panel when you book, or pick a room with a partition. The hotel has only 40 rooms, so if you know the date of a home match or a race event, book straight away — it fills fast and prices climb hard.
pros: Lovely loft-style room design, photographs well, a break from the chains around the stadium
About 800 m from Chang Arena and Chang Circuit — within walking distance
Lovely saltwater pool with a kids' zone, gym, steam room, massage room
Spacious, clean rooms, comfortable beds, professional and friendly staff
cons: Glass-walled bathroom — some couples will have to accept the lack of privacy
Dark-toned lighting makes the room rather dim · TV signal unsteady in some rooms
Small hotel of 40 rooms · on a main road, so without a car you rely on Grab to reach town

entries.name: Kesorn Boutique Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 In town, Chumhet, behind the hospital · Chang Arena ~10 km
tags: 🌿 In town but quiet and peaceful
entries.storyHtml: If you're coming to Buriram without focusing on a big match day at Chang and want an in-town stay with rooms that look new, clean, and peaceful, easy parking, and a gentle price, Kesorn Boutique Hotel is a name that turns up often in reviews. · It's a small boutique hotel of 36 rooms in a modern contemporary style, in the Chumhet sub-district behind Buriram Hospital, just about 1 km from the city centre, scoring 8.4 from 482 reviews on Agoda. · The location's strength is being "in town but not hectic" — the hotel sits on a quiet lane, off the busy main road, yet it's about a 5-minute drive into town, to Saraka Krao Market, or to the town's restaurants. · The overall design is modern in dark tones set against marble and wood that many reviews say "looks pricier than expected"; every room has a private balcony, AC, a fridge, a minibar, a 32-inch TV, and free Wi-Fi. · Real reviews agree the rooms are very clean, look new, the beds are comfortable, the AC is ice-cold, and it's quiet — good for light sleepers who want a proper rest. · For anyone driving in themselves or visiting a patient at the nearby Buriram Hospital, a much-praised point is the spacious, convenient free parking, plus bicycles to borrow for getting around town. · There's a garden and green terrace around the building with a nicely decorated lounge corner. · One thing to be upfront about from the start is that this hotel is adults only and has no pool — so if you're bringing young children or want a pool for the kids, this isn't the answer; look at a hotel with a pool like The Crystal or Modena instead. · Other honest caveats: the location is a residential area with no public transport nearby, so you'll need a car or Grab; some rooms and bathrooms aren't very large; some room doors are fairly thin and you'll hear the corridor; breakfast information differs across platforms, so check before booking; and it's about 10 km from Chang Arena. · Best suited to couples, two travellers, anyone here on business or visiting a patient at the hospital, and anyone breaking a journey in town along the Lower Isan route.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Some room doors are fairly thin, so if you're a light sleeper, request a room set deeper from the corridor when you book. Breakfast information differs across platforms and at times there's none or it's charged separately, so ask the hotel directly when you book. There are bicycles to borrow for getting around town on a fine day.
pros: In town but quiet and peaceful, on a quiet lane, about 1 km from the city centre
Modern rooms that look new, design that looks pricier than the rate, every room with a balcony
Spacious free parking, bicycles to borrow, near Buriram Hospital
Friendly, attentive staff · good value for a one- or two-night stay
cons: Adults only and no pool — not suitable for families with young children
Residential location, no public transport nearby, you'll need a car/Grab
Some rooms aren't very large, doors are thin · check breakfast before booking

entries.name: Hop Inn Buriram

entries.addr: 517/27 Jira Road, Nai Mueang sub-district, Mueang Buriram
entries.storyHtml: If you're coming to Buriram on a tight budget and want a clean, comfortable room in a location that's easy to reach town from, without paying more than you need to, Hop Inn Buriram is the name budget travellers mention most, and it's the cheapest starting rate in this article. · It's a 2-star budget hotel in the Hop Inn brand from The Erawan group — the largest single-price hotel chain in Thailand — on Jira Road in the town centre, with 79 rooms, from about ฿600/night, scoring 9.3 on Trip.com and 8.4 on Booking.com. · The selling point is the in-town location that sits between several key spots — there are restaurants, convenience stores, and a market close by, unlike many hotels that are stadium-side but far from town. · For anyone here for football or racing, i-mobile Stadium (Chang Arena) is about a 5–8 minute drive, and Chang International Circuit about a 10–15 minute drive, while the Buriram bus terminal (BKS) is close by — ideal for anyone arriving by coach or minivan who wants a stay near the drop-off point. · Hop Inn uses a single-price concept where every room costs the same and is a similar size (about 19.6 sqm), differing only in bed type, so booking is easy with little to choose; the décor is plain and clean in bright tones, focused on function, with AC, a TV, a fridge, a soft bed, and a water heater in every room. · What real reviews agree on most is the cleanliness of the rooms and the hot-water pressure that's better than the price, with many saying the rooms are cleaner and larger than expected. · There's free parking that many reviews call spacious and safe, a 24-hour front desk, and free Wi-Fi. · One thing to understand about the Hop Inn concept from the start is that there's no pool, no gym, and no breakfast included — cutting the non-essentials to keep the price low — but the in-town location on Jira Road has restaurants and convenience stores around the hotel where you can head out and eat at local prices. · Honest caveats: the in-town roadside location means some rooms catch noise from the market and evening activity, which can bother light sleepers, and some reviews say the Wi-Fi isn't stable enough for sustained high-speed work. · Best suited to budget travellers, people passing through, football and motorsport fans who want to save on lodging and put the budget toward match tickets, and workers in town for a short errand.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Understand the Hop Inn concept before booking — no pool, no gym, no breakfast included — set your expectations on cleanliness and location and it's great value. If you're a light sleeper, ask for a higher floor or a room not facing the main road, and if you need sustained fast internet for work, keep mobile data as a backup.
pros: Single price from ฿600/night — cheapest in this article, better value than expected for a budget stay
In-town location, near the bus terminal and a 5–8 minute drive to Chang Arena
Very clean rooms, strong hot water, comfortable beds
Spacious, safe free parking, free Wi-Fi, 24-hour front desk
cons: No pool, no gym, and no breakfast included, in line with the budget concept
In-town location catches some market and evening-activity noise in the rooms
Wi-Fi unstable at times for work that needs sustained high speed (from reviews)

advice.bodyHtml: → Amari Buriram United ฿1,800, on the same grounds as the stadium, a 2-min walk, Buriram United theme, top score 9.7 · or Modena by Fraser ฿1,290, a 5-min walk to the stadium, the most reviews

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates from the standard-room price range and may change by date and season; we recommend checking the real price and comparing 3 sites before every booking. · The scores and highlights in this article come from reading real guest reviews on booking platforms — we did not stay ourselves. · The Crystal Hotel Buriram was formerly named X2 Vibe / Cross Vibe Buriram — it's the same place. · During big Buriram United home matches or MotoGP and Superbike race events, hotels across town fill fast and prices climb hard, so book several weeks to several months ahead and pick Free Cancellation just in case. · Buriram has no metro; a private car, rental car, or Grab is most convenient — from Buriram Airport (BFV) it's about 30–40 minutes into town. · Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — questions travellers ask most about staying in Buriram

faq.q: ❓ Which Buriram stay is closest to Chang Arena?
faq.a: The closest is Amari Buriram United, on the same grounds as Chang Arena (Thunder Castle), a 2-minute walk to the stadium gate, and Modena by Fraser Buriram, also right by the stadium, about a 5-minute walk. · Next are Cresco Hotel and The Crystal Hotel, about 800 metres to 5 km away, within walking distance or a 10-minute drive. · As for an in-town hotel like Hop Inn, it's about a 5–8 minute drive from the stadium.

faq.q: ❓ How much do Buriram hotels cost?
faq.a: In this article, prices start at about ฿600–1,800 per night. · The most budget end is Hop Inn from ฿600 and Klim Hotel from ฿850. · Mid-range is Venezia ฿900, Best Western Royal and Kesorn ฿1,100, Alvarez and Cresco ฿1,200, Modena ฿1,290, and The Crystal ฿1,400. · And the top end is Amari Buriram United from ฿1,800. · All prices are approximate starting rates from a standard room; during big matches or race events, prices can be several times higher than usual.

faq.q: ❓ Which area is best to stay in if you're here to watch football at Chang Arena?
faq.a: The area around the stadium (Isan / Samet sub-districts) is best if your focus is walking to the stadium on match day — Amari, Modena, Cresco, and The Crystal are in this zone, within walking distance or a few minutes' drive, but restaurants are scarce nearby, so have a car ready. · The in-town area (Nai Mueang / Chumhet sub-districts) suits anyone who wants food easy to find, near the markets and the railway station / bus terminal — Best Western Royal, Alvarez, Klim, Kesorn, and Hop Inn are in this zone, about a 10–15 minute drive to the stadium.

faq.q: ❓ Which Buriram stay is good for families bringing kids?
faq.a: If you want a pool for the kids, Venezia Resort has a waterfall pool with a kids' slide · The Crystal Hotel has a saltwater pool, a kids' pool, and Pool Access rooms where you step straight into the pool · Modena by Fraser has two pools and family rooms · Cresco has a saltwater pool and a kids' zone · Amari has bunk-bed rooms and a pool. · Kesorn Boutique is adults only and Hop Inn has no pool, so they're not suitable if you're bringing kids to swim.

faq.q: ❓ Coming to Buriram without your own car — where's convenient to stay?
faq.a: Buriram has no metro, so without a car you should pick an in-town stay where you can find food on foot and that's near the drop-off points. · Klim Hotel is ~800 metres across from the railway station, within walking distance · Hop Inn is near the bus terminal. · As for the stadium-zone hotels like Amari, Modena, and Cresco, without a car you'll rely on Grab to reach town because restaurants are scarce nearby — but on match day the stadium-side location is the most convenient because you can walk there.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should you book a Buriram stay?
faq.a: In normal periods, booking 1–2 weeks ahead is enough. · But during a big Buriram United home match or a MotoGP/Superbike race event, book several weeks to several months ahead, because hotels across town get fully booked and prices climb hard — especially small hotels like Amari (60 rooms) and Cresco (40 rooms), which fill very fast. · Every platform has Free Cancellation, so we recommend locking that in if your plans aren't certain yet, then comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price.
